item.tib: dpal ldan lha mo'i yang snying gi rgyud las tshe sgrub 'chi med g.yung drung
item.coloph: tshe yi sgrub pa 'chi med g.yung drung 'di/ 'gro ba tshe zad tshe sring don ched du/ sems bskyed rta zhon brtson 'grus lcags kyis brab/ 'khrul med bde chen thang yang sleb bya ste/ khams btsun mi la'i ming can bdag gis sbyar/ nongs 'gal ci mchis bla ma lha la bshags/ mkha' 'gro bon skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob nas/ gshen bstan gsal ba'i sgron me gyur par shog/
